# pragma version 0.4.3
# A score that only its deployer can raise.
import IScore

implements: IScore

owner: public(immutable(address))
label: public(String[32])
_score: uint256

event Bumped:
    by: uint256
    score: uint256


@deploy
def __init__(initial: uint256, label_: String[32]):
    owner = msg.sender
    self.label = label_
    self._score = initial


@external
@view
def score() -> uint256:
    return self._score


@external
def bump(by: uint256):
    assert msg.sender == owner, "not owner"
    self._score += by
    log Bumped(by=by, score=self._score)
